manifest.description: Diagnose wasted intermediate work: eager materialization of a collection before a filter/take/streaming boundary, and redundant serialization (parse/stringify or encode/decode round-trips) within one scope.
when_to_use: a full collection is built then immediately filtered, truncated, or reduced
a value is serialized and deserialized (or encoded/decoded) within the same scope without crossing a boundary that needs it
an iterator chain is collected to a Vec only to be iterated again
a profile or operator hint points at allocation or copy time in a transform pipeline
anti_patterns: do not flag a materialization that is reused multiple times downstream
do not flag serialization that genuinely crosses a process/network/storage boundary
do not propose streaming rewrites that change ordering or error semantics without saying so
do not use for micro-allocations off the hot path
